text: For backyard chickens, priority vaccines are Newcastle Disease (live vaccine by eye drop or drinking water — used immediately after mixing, since leftover reconstituted vaccine cannot be saved; or an inactivated, ready-to-use vaccine that can be kept 2–8°C for several days and is given by injection) and Fowl Pox (live vaccine, given specifically via the wing web route). For semi-commercial flocks kept in premises, supplementary vaccination against Gumboro and Infectious Bronchitis (IB) is recommended.
